description: Step semantics of the server-authoritative engine: the JSON of Step.toJSON() in the release of prosemirror-transform named here, applied against the generated CDM ProseMirror schema named here. A release that changes any fixture output is a new engine identifier.

alsoPinned.name: prosemirror-model
alsoPinned.why: Applying a step runs the replace algorithm and the content checks of prosemirror-model.

comparison: Documents are compared in the CDM canonical form (03 §2) and by the SHA-256 of its RFC 8785 text; steps by their JSON. A failing step is identified by its index.
